responsibility: Defines the core rs6000 target-side option and ABI enumerations shared by option parsing and backend code. It declares stable enums for processor_type, floating-point unit variants, scheduling and nop-insertion policies, ABI kinds, small-data models, traceback format, code model, vector-unit selection, and stack-protector guard source, providing the typed option vocabulary that powerpcspe.opt and the rest of the backend store in target variables.
